criteria_results.notes: Build Summary: 33/33 steps succeeded; 85/174 tests passed (89 skipped). All EE-11 unit tests pass (TC-EE-11-U01, TC-EE-11-U02, TC-EE-11-U03). No regressions in other suites.

criteria_results.criterion: AC-1: Replay of N events via pure transition function produces InstanceState equal to persisted projection
criteria_results.notes: reconstructInstance() iterates events from events + events_archive tables in order and replays each through transition.zig. Function is publicly accessible (TC-EE-11-U03 confirms). Full field-for-field equality verified by integration tests deferred to live-DB run.

criteria_results.criterion: AC-2: Reconstruction possible even if projection table is corrupt or absent
criteria_results.notes: reconstructInstance() reads directly from the event log; it does not depend on instance_projections for input. write_back parameter controls whether results are written back.

criteria_results.criterion: AC-3: Reconstruction spanning events and events_archive (ES-07) produces identical results
criteria_results.notes: Implementation fetches from both tables in sequence. Verified structurally; runtime equality deferred to integration environment.

criteria_results.criterion: AC-4: Instance with 0 events returns InstanceNotFound
criteria_results.notes: ReconstructionError.InstanceNotFound is returned when no events exist for the instance_id. Error variant confirmed by TC-EE-11-U01.

criteria_results.criterion: AC-5: EXECUTION_ERROR in event log sets reconstructed status to ERROR
criteria_results.notes: Transition function sets instance status to ERROR on EXECUTION_ERROR event. Verified structurally; runtime path deferred to integration environment.

criteria_results.criterion: NFR-04: Reconstruction of 10,000-event instance completes in ≤ 5 seconds
criteria_results.notes: NFR-04: DEFERRED pending integration environment. Implementation is O(1) per event with no writes during replay (write_back=false path). No in-memory allocation per event beyond transition state. Full 10,000-event timing test (TC-EE-11-05) requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL. Acceptable for this stage.
